description: Implementation of the FutexWaiter class for synchronization, including wait, post, and poke methods, using futex system calls and kernel timeouts.

classes.name: FutexWaiter
classes.description: A class providing futex-based waiting and notification mechanisms for thread synchronization.

methods.name: WaitUntil
methods.description: Waits on an atomic integer until a specified value or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits on the futex until it is signaled or timeout.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Increments the futex and potentially wakes a waiting thread.

methods.name: Poke
methods.description: Wakes one thread waiting on the futex.
